stories.title: Create /feed.xml RSS feed endpoint for blog posts
stories.description: Implement RSS 2.0 feed generation at /feed.xml including channel metadata and all blog posts with publication dates. Enables feed reader subscriptions and content syndication.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /feed.xml returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with Content-Type: application/rss+xml
Feed includes channel title 'Pelangi Capsule Blog', description, and link to /blog home
Each blog post appears as <item> with title, description, pubDate (RFC 2822), link, and guid

File to create: site/lib/blog/generateRssFeed.ts (XML builder function)
Import getAllBlogPosts from site/lib/blog to iterate posts in route
Test command: npm run build && curl http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | grep '<rss version="2.0">' && npm run dev
Validate at https://validator.w3.org/feed/

stories.title: Update sitemap.ts to include all blog post URLs with metadata
stories.description: Extend Next.js sitemap.ts to dynamically inject all blog post routes with publication dates and SEO priority. Ensures search engine crawlers discover all blog content.
acceptanceCriteria: sitemap.ts calls getAllBlogPosts() and maps each post to MetadataRoute.Sitemap entry with url, lastModified (ISO 8601 from post.publishedAt), changefreq: 'weekly', priority: 0.7
Build completes without errors and generated sitemap.xml includes all blog post URLs (e.g. /blog/taman-pelangi)
Homepage and core pages retain priority: 1.0; blog index /blog gets priority: 0.8
technicalNotes: File to modify: site/app/sitemap.ts (add blog posts section after homepage entry)
Import type MetadataRoute from 'next' and getAllBlogPosts from site/lib/blog
Map posts: posts.map(post => ({ url: `${baseUrl}/blog/${post.slug}`, lastModified: post.publishedAt, changefreq: 'weekly', priority: 0.7 }))
Test command: npm run build && grep -c '/blog/' public/sitemap.xml (should equal blog post count) && curl http://localhost:3000/sitemap.xml | grep taman-pelangi

stories.title: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema to blog post pages
stories.description: Implement BreadcrumbList structured data on blog post pages showing Home > Blog > Post Title hierarchy. Improves SEO by signaling content structure to search engines and enables breadcrumb rich snippets.
acceptanceCriteria: BlogBreadcrumbs component renders visible HTML nav with semantic <ol> and <li> elements showing Home → Blog → Post Title links
Component emits BreadcrumbList JSON-LD in <script type='application/ld+json'> with 3 itemListElement objects (position 1-3)
Blog post page.tsx integrates component via <BlogBreadcrumbs slug={slug} title={post.title} /> and includes schema in head
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/components/BlogBreadcrumbs.tsx (renders nav + emits JSON-LD)
File to modify: site/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (import and render component, ensure JSON-LD in <head>)

Schema keys: @context 'https://schema.org', @type 'BreadcrumbList', itemListElement: [{position: 1, name: 'Home', item: baseUrl}, {position: 2, name: 'Blog', item: `${baseUrl}/blog`}, {position: 3, name: post.title, item: current URL}]
Test command: npx vitest run src/components/BlogBreadcrumbs.test.tsx -- --coverage && npm run dev
Validate: Use https://validator.schema.org/ on rendered /blog/taman-pelangi page

stories.title: Create /api/og/blog route for dynamic blog post Open Graph images
stories.description: Implement next/og ImageResponse to generate 1200x630px OG images per blog post with title, author, and hostel branding. Improves social sharing click-through rates and brand consistency on LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/og/blog?slug=taman-pelangi returns PNG image (200 OK, Content-Type: image/png) with post title, author name, 'Pelangi Capsule' branding, and publication date
Blog post generateMetadata dynamically sets og:image to https://pelangi.my/api/og/blog?slug={slug}
Invalid slug or missing post returns fallback brand image without error
technicalNotes: File to create: site/app/api/og/blog/route.ts (ImageResponse handler using next/og Satori engine)
File to modify: site/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (update generateMetadata function to set og:image URL)
Route handler: const { slug } = searchParams; const post = await getBlogPost(slug); return new ImageResponse(...)
ImageResponse dimensions: 1200×630 with Tailwind-style layout (Satori uses Flexbox)
Test command: npm run build && curl 'http://localhost:3000/api/og/blog?slug=taman-pelangi' -o test.png && file test.png
Verify og:image: npm run dev && curl -s http://localhost:3000/blog/taman-pelangi | grep '<meta property="og:image"'
